messages:
Nina: FYI planning infra apply in release quiet window tomorrow 01:00 UTC. Items: route table tweak, egress ACL, and cross-account IAM trust change. Will do a single-region canary then roll. Any concerns? :wave:
Rohit: Sounds fine. Please pin the provider in the root module so we don't get surprises from provider bumps. Also request a tfstate snapshot before apply.
Lee: +1 to pin + snapshot. Recommend canary in us-west-2 only, 20m soak. If anything looks off we abort and run revert.
deploybot: change window reserved by @Nina for 2025-11-11 01:00 UTC — non-overlapping deploy enforced. Required checks: tf fmt, tf validate, plan approval.
infra-bot: detached terraform plan ready — summary: adds=5 changes=2 deletes=0. Notable: prod-vpc route update, IAM role principal change. Plan: https://ci.internal/plans/987654
Nina: Rollback triggers proposed: 1) request error rate >0.5% for 10m OR 2) p95 latency +40% for 10m during canary. If triggered, run revert apply and notify oncall.
Rohit: Provider pin suggestion to add to root module:
```hcl
terraform {
  required_providers {
    aws = {
      source = "hashicorp/aws"
      version = "~> 4.71"
    }
  }
}
```
Lee: I'll own the canary validation. Smoke test: health check + assume-role. I'll post the script later today.
Nina: infra-bot please create tfstate snapshot and tag with release id. Also I'll prepare the revert apply plan and upload to runbook.
infra-bot: snapshot complete -> s3://redwood-backups/2025-11-11/release-1775004321.tfstate.gz
oncall: Acknowledge — will be standby for rollback execution.
Rohit: Keep per-region apply window to 25m. After canary and 15m observation, proceed with 10m windows per region.
Nina: Assign owners: Nina=release owner/runbook, Lee=canary validation, Rohit=provider pin + plan approver, oncall=rollback executor. I'll lock merges 30m before window. :lock:
deploybot: Reminder scheduled 30m before window start.
Nina: Thanks all, will post final runbook + smoke script tonight.
